MANUAL.clock_map_used: monotone piecewise-linear interpolation of the /clock stream (published once per physics step)
MANUAL.timebase_caveat: I15: gz.msgs.Double_V carries no header, so actuator/aero sample times are RECONSTRUCTED from wall arrival time through the /clock map. Only the IMU carries a true publisher stamp. The per-topic transport latency DIFFERENCE between /clock and the actuator topic is UNMEASURED and is the real uncontrolled term (m14).
